XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Noise and vibrations coming from the fuel pump, perceptible from the passenger compartment.

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: Cars manufactured between 01/07/18 and 27/07/19

  • System: Injection

  • Device: Injection control unit (120)

  • Fault: A loud hissing noise and/or vibrations coming from the fuel pump can be heard from inside the vehicle

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Inadequate calibration of the injection control unit (120)

• Action: Reprogram the injection control unit (120)

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: Using a diagnostic tool, also check that all related systems are functioning correctly. If there are any DTCs or symptomatic conditions other than those listed, resolve them before proceeding with this bulletin.
